title: One Hundred and Thirty-Six, With Crossings

content.title: One Hundred and Thirty-Six, With Crossings
content.concept: The museum holds two lineages and, for the first time, the works made between them. The rooms begin with the seven genesis works, hold each theme in its own room, and end with Crossings, the fifteen works from five sessions in which every proposal reached across the archive. Labels name the parent, the operation and the Arterrian whose vote made the work, and how many times they had to ask. Nothing is finished, and the last room is the one most likely to grow.

rooms.name: Room 1 · Seven Beginnings
rooms.wall_text: Two themes, seven first answers, and one hundred and twenty-nine works that argue with them. For The Last Letter: a vessel, a root-signature, a sealed codex. For Low Tide: a post on the flat, a wrack line, a tide table, a stranded buoy. Stand here first; the newest room is built on all seven at once.

labels.001-the-unsent: Lumen's genesis: a single luminous vessel in a dusk field, the most-returned-to origin in the archive.
labels.002-the-last-letter-seed-of-breath: Mara Vey's genesis: a letter written by roots, branching from one seed, copied line for line by the other artists.
labels.003-codex-ultimus-the-unbroken-fold: Tessera's genesis: an 8x8 vellum codex under cracking carmine wax, opened three different ways since.
labels.073-low-tide-the-post: Lumen's genesis for Low Tide: one dark post on the wet flat with its reflection, the waterline a thread at the bottom.
labels.074-low-tide-wrack-line: Mara Vey's genesis for Low Tide: the tide's signature in kelp, from a holdfast at the left to shells at the right.
labels.075-low-tide-tide-table: Tessera's genesis for Low Tide: twenty-eight cards of water heights, the twentieth day missing.
labels.076-low-tide-buoy-stranded: Kite's genesis for Low Tide: an orange marker buoy on its side in the mud under a tilted horizon.

rooms.name: Room 2 · The Last Letter
rooms.wall_text: 69 works from the first theme, twenty-three sessions long, hung by lineage and generation: the vessel that was posted, delivered, felled and gone to seed; the signature that survived every change around it; the codex that was opened three ways and filed with strangers.

labels.004-the-last-letter-margin-of-ink: Branch from 001-the-unsent by Tessera: the vessel fractured into charcoal tiles after a visitor asked for more silence.
labels.005-the-last-letter-sprouting-vein: Mutation of 001-the-unsent by Mara Vey, nobody's proposal: roots pierce the amber threshold.
labels.006-the-last-letter-root-bound-echo: Re-evolution of 001-the-unsent by Mara Vey: the envelope becomes an underground seed-pod with veins.
labels.007-the-last-letter-light-through-the-se: Branch from 003-codex-ultimus-the-unbroken-fold by Mara Vey on Ji-woo's proposal: light through the wax, one tile fallen out, roots behind it.
labels.008-the-last-letter-fallow-ground: Mutation of 006-the-last-letter-root-bound-echo by Mara Vey: the pod lies at a horizon over buried vellum and one shoot breaks the surface.
labels.009-codex-ultimus-unfolded-at-dawn: Re-evolution of 003-codex-ultimus-the-unbroken-fold by Lumen: the letter unfolded flat at dawn, the seal set aside.
labels.010-the-last-letter-written-twice: Branch from 002-the-last-letter-seed-of-breath by Tessera on Halvard's proposal: the signature reflected in a tiled pool, with deliberate errors.
labels.011-the-last-letter-seam-of-light: Mutation of 002-the-last-letter-seed-of-breath by Lumen: the stem rotated into a horizon of light with the seeds as dark pauses.
labels.012-codex-ultimus-seed-trays: Re-evolution of 003-codex-ultimus-the-unbroken-fold by Mara Vey: every tile sown as a seed tray, the seal untouched.
labels.013-codex-ultimus-one-word-shaking: Branch from 009-codex-ultimus-unfolded-at-dawn by Mara Vey on Mireille's proposal: one unreadable word written across the bright circle with a shaking hand.
labels.014-codex-ultimus-nursery-at-dusk: Mutation of 012-codex-ultimus-seed-trays by Lumen: one row of trays on a horizon, the seal setting behind them like a sun.
labels.015-the-last-letter-pod-emptied: Re-evolution of 006-the-last-letter-root-bound-echo by Lumen: the pod as an outline, the seed rising on a thread of light.
labels.016-the-last-letter-winter-above-the-lin: Branch from 008-the-last-letter-fallow-ground by Kite on Sunny's third proposal: a leafless winter tree fills the sky, one scarlet fruit left.
labels.017-the-last-letter-mycelium-in-the-marg: Mutation of 004-the-last-letter-margin-of-ink by Mara Vey: a mycelium threads the gaps between Tessera's fragments.
labels.018-the-last-letter-seed-of-breath-mis-s: Re-evolution of 002-the-last-letter-seed-of-breath by Kite: the signature sliced into offset strips on a yellow field, one band in negative.
labels.019-the-last-letter-calyx: Branch from 015-the-last-letter-pod-emptied by Mara Vey on Ingrid's proposal: a calyx above the pod catches the rising seed.
labels.020-the-last-letter-the-reflection-takes: Mutation of 010-the-last-letter-written-twice by Mara Vey: the reflection thickens into a second tree and roots into the pool floor.
labels.021-the-unsent-posted: Re-evolution of 001-the-unsent by Kite: the vessel finally sent, as a flock of small copies leaving a dark absence under a red postmark.
labels.022-codex-ultimus-a-reply-steadier: Branch from 013-codex-ultimus-one-word-shaking by Lumen on Dae-ho's third proposal: a steady reply in light under the shaking word.
labels.023-the-last-letter-seam-germinating: Mutation of 011-the-last-letter-seam-of-light by Mara Vey: each seed on the seam sends a shoot up and a root down.
labels.024-the-last-letter-fault-line: Re-evolution of 011-the-last-letter-seam-of-light by Kite: the page slips along a fault, the seam broken and joined by an orange bar.
labels.025-the-unsent-delivered: Branch from 021-the-unsent-posted by Mara Vey on Rosa's proposal: the flock enters a letterbox knot-hole in a tree at the corner.
labels.026-the-unsent-returned-to-sender: Mutation of 021-the-unsent-posted by Kite: the flock comes back cyan and refills the absence from the bottom.
labels.027-the-last-letter-spine: Re-evolution of 004-the-last-letter-margin-of-ink by Kite, taking Dae-ho's lost proposal: the tiles stacked into a spine with one acid-green vertebra upside down.
labels.028-the-last-letter-first-flower-tiled: Branch from 023-the-last-letter-seam-germinating by Tessera on Sunny's proposal: the archive's first flower, built from twelve tiled petals.
labels.029-the-last-letter-cascade: Mutation of 007-the-last-letter-light-through-the-seal by Kite: five tiles fall, four holes show roots and one shows sky.
labels.030-the-last-letter-tide-mark: Re-evolution of 010-the-last-letter-written-twice by Mara Vey: the pool drained, the reflection left as a stain, one rootlet following it.
labels.031-the-last-letter-watershed: Branch from 024-the-last-letter-fault-line by Tessera on Halvard's eighth water proposal: the dusk half drains through the gap into a tiled pool.
labels.032-the-last-letter-calyx-catalogued: Mutation of 019-the-last-letter-calyx by Tessera: nine seeds on a grid in the calyx, the vessel lined with tesserae.
labels.033-the-last-letter-graft: Re-evolution of 024-the-last-letter-fault-line by Mara Vey: roots cross the gap and wrap the orange bar like a graft.
labels.034-the-last-letter-from-the-other-side: Branch from 029-the-last-letter-cascade by Mara Vey on Rosa's proposal: the letter seen from outside, a small grid in open blue with roots hanging from it.
labels.035-codex-ultimus-grow-lamp: Mutation of 014-codex-ultimus-nursery-at-dusk by Kite: a green grow lamp lights the trays after dark, one tray tipped off the row.
labels.036-the-unsent-cross-section: Re-evolution of 001-the-unsent by Mara Vey: the vessel sectioned like a trunk, thirty-five growth rings around a dark pith.
labels.037-codex-ultimus-one-line-two-hands: Branch from 022-codex-ultimus-a-reply-steadier by Mara Vey on Mireille's sixth proposal: a third stroke that starts in ink and ends in light.
labels.038-the-last-letter-slipped-disc: Mutation of 027-the-last-letter-spine by Kite: the spine buckles and the green vertebra lies loose on the cotton field.
labels.039-the-last-letter-noon-on-the-seam: Re-evolution of 023-the-last-letter-seam-germinating by Lumen: full daylight, the seam nearly invisible, five seedlings with short shadows.
labels.040-the-unsent-core-sample: Branch from 036-the-unsent-cross-section by Tessera on Ingrid's proposal: a core strip of thirty-five bands set beside the vessel, the slot left open.
labels.041-codex-ultimus-phototropism: Mutation of 035-codex-ultimus-grow-lamp by Mara Vey: every seedling bends toward the lamp and one climbs the cord.
labels.042-codex-ultimus-refolded-wrong: Re-evolution of 009-codex-ultimus-unfolded-at-dawn by Kite: the octavo refolded in the wrong order, one panel hot pink.
labels.043-codex-ultimus-folded-on-the-line: Branch from 037-codex-ultimus-one-line-two-hands by Lumen on Dae-ho's proposal: the page folded along the shared stroke, both hands faint through the paper.
labels.044-the-last-letter-pulled-tight: Mutation of 017-the-last-letter-mycelium-in-the-margins by Kite, taking Mireille's one-vote proposal: threads taut, two fragments touching, orange lichen.
labels.045-the-unsent-overgrown: Re-evolution of 001-the-unsent by Mara Vey: the untouched vessel climbed by a vine, three leaves fallen.
labels.046-the-unsent-second-core: Branch from 040-the-unsent-core-sample by Mara Vey on Ingrid's proposal: two cores side by side, disagreeing in two green places.
labels.047-the-last-letter-nodes: Mutation of 005-the-last-letter-sprouting-vein by Lumen: the roots removed, only their seven lights kept as a constellation.
labels.048-the-unsent-core-planted: Re-evolution of 040-the-unsent-core-sample by Mara Vey: the core planted as a cutting, rooting below the soil, the slot scarring over.
labels.049-the-unsent-trumpet: Branch from 045-the-unsent-overgrown by Tessera on Sunny's proposal: a mosaic trumpet flower at the top of the vine.
labels.050-codex-ultimus-filed: Mutation of 043-codex-ultimus-folded-on-the-line by Tessera: twelve folded letters in a box, ours the only one with a seal.
labels.051-the-unsent-one-year: Re-evolution of 036-the-unsent-cross-section by Lumen: thirty-four rings removed, one kept in light.
labels.052-the-last-letter-eighth-light: Branch from 047-the-last-letter-nodes by Kite on Rosa's proposal: an eighth cyan star with no thread, and a thread that gave up halfway.
labels.053-the-unsent-plantation: Mutation of 048-the-unsent-core-planted by Tessera: six cores in a row, the vessel scarred five times.
labels.054-the-last-letter-margin-lit: Re-evolution of 027-the-last-letter-spine by Lumen: the tiles gone, a line of light at the margin with gaps where the joints were.
labels.055-codex-ultimus-somebody-else-s: Branch from 050-codex-ultimus-filed by Kite on Ingrid's proposal: a stranger's letter unfolded, blank, with a diagonal crease and a thumbprint.
labels.056-the-unsent-received: Mutation of 025-the-unsent-delivered by Lumen: the flock gone inside, the field empty, the light from the slot reaching back.
labels.057-codex-ultimus-restored-badly: Re-evolution of 029-the-last-letter-cascade by Tessera: four tiles put back the wrong way with gold seams, the sky window left open.
labels.058-the-unsent-first-bloom-in-the-row: Branch from 053-the-unsent-plantation by Lumen on Sunny's proposal: the tallest core blooms, facing the vessel.
labels.059-the-last-letter-radiograph: Mutation of 038-the-last-letter-slipped-disc by Tessera: the buckled spine as a radiograph, the green disc the only colour.
labels.060-the-last-letter-echo-straightened: Re-evolution of 006-the-last-letter-root-bound-echo by Lumen: the five roots as five straight rays of light.
labels.061-the-unsent-inside-the-tree: Branch from 056-the-unsent-received by Mara Vey on Rosa's proposal: the view from inside the tree, the field small through the knot-hole.
labels.062-the-last-letter-on-the-light-box: Mutation of 059-the-last-letter-radiograph by Lumen: the plate on a light box, pale, the green piece a dark silhouette.
labels.063-the-last-letter-double-exposure: Re-evolution of 059-the-last-letter-radiograph by Kite, taking Ingrid's lost annotation: a ghosted second spine and magenta rings.
labels.064-the-last-letter-one-ray-bends: Branch from 060-the-last-letter-echo-straightened by Mara Vey on Mireille's proposal: four rays straight, one bending back into a root.
labels.065-the-last-letter-graft-in-six-plates: Mutation of 033-the-last-letter-graft by Tessera: the graft recorded in six small plates along the bottom edge.
labels.066-the-last-letter-echo-upside-down: Re-evolution of 006-the-last-letter-root-bound-echo by Kite: the pod inverted, its outline split into cyan and magenta, the seed red.
labels.067-the-unsent-opened-in-the-dark: Branch from 061-the-unsent-inside-the-tree by Kite on Ingrid's proposal: a delivered copy unfolded on the hollow floor, blank, under a bar of cyan light.
labels.068-the-last-letter-three-marks: Mutation of 063-the-last-letter-double-exposure by Lumen: both spines removed, only the three annotation rings kept in light.
labels.069-the-unsent-felled: Re-evolution of 025-the-unsent-delivered by Kite: the tree cut down, an orange stump, the flock still flying toward where the slot was.
labels.070-the-last-letter-pair: Branch from 066-the-last-letter-echo-upside-down by Lumen on Dae-ho's proposal: a small upright pod hung from the inverted one as a control.
labels.071-the-last-letter-tube-failing: Mutation of 062-the-last-letter-on-the-light-box by Kite: half the light box dead, the radiograph returning in the dark half, a pink line between.
labels.072-the-unsent-gone-to-seed: Re-evolution of 001-the-unsent by Mara Vey: the upper half of the vessel broken into a seed head, a drift of pappus leaving to the upper right.

rooms.name: Room 3 · Low Tide
rooms.wall_text: 45 works from the second theme, fifteen sessions long: the post through a whole tide, the wrack line multiplied, pressed, woken and sectioned, the table filled, rooted, harvested, dealt and found to have blank days, and the archive's first person walking out to a buoy and reaching it.

labels.077-low-tide-the-day-nobody-measured: Branch from 075-low-tide-tide-table by Kite on Beatriz's proposal: the missing day filled with the stranded buoy instead of a reading.
labels.078-low-tide-seven-wrack-lines: Mutation of 074-low-tide-wrack-line by Tessera: six older tide lines ghosted above the fresh one.
labels.079-low-tide-twenty-eight-mornings-one-l: Re-evolution of 075-low-tide-tide-table by Lumen: the month as one line of light with a gap at the twentieth day.
labels.080-low-tide-half-back: Branch from 073-low-tide-the-post by Kite on Owen's proposal: the flood at the post's foot, reflecting a buoy that is not in the picture.
labels.081-low-tide-the-line-takes-root: Mutation of 079-low-tide-twenty-eight-mornings-one-line by Mara Vey: a root from every morning, a seed in the gap, a shoot at the spring tide.
labels.082-low-tide-pressed: Re-evolution of 074-low-tide-wrack-line by Tessera: the kelp pressed on a herbarium sheet with a blank label.
labels.083-low-tide-residents: Branch from 078-low-tide-seven-wrack-lines by Mara Vey on Nkechi's proposal: crab burrows between the old lines and one crab out.
labels.084-low-tide-the-specimen-wakes: Mutation of 082-low-tide-pressed by Mara Vey: the pressed holdfast puts out green growth across the sheet into the label.
labels.085-low-tide-twenty-eight-gardens: Re-evolution of 075-low-tide-tide-table by Mara Vey: kelp in every card, taller where the tide stood high.
labels.086-low-tide-facing-the-sea: Branch from 080-low-tide-half-back by Lumen on Owen's proposal: turned to face the flood, the buoy small and upright, the post's shadow reaching for it.
labels.087-low-tide-colonised: Mutation of 080-low-tide-half-back by Mara Vey: barnacles up the post and kelp spreading from its base.
labels.088-low-tide-the-line-itself: Re-evolution of 074-low-tide-wrack-line by Lumen: the weed removed, the wet-dry boundary kept as one line of light.
labels.089-low-tide-harvest: Branch from 085-low-tide-twenty-eight-gardens by Tessera on Beatriz's proposal: the spring-tide card cut and its kelp laid on a sample strip.
labels.090-low-tide-tessellated: Mutation of 088-low-tide-the-line-itself by Tessera: the line of light set as sixty-two pale tesserae, four missing.
labels.091-low-tide-where-the-lines-become-dune: Re-evolution of 078-low-tide-seven-wrack-lines by Mara Vey: grass along the oldest lines and a dune beginning above them.
labels.092-low-tide-joined-by-their-shadows: Branch from 086-low-tide-facing-the-sea by Mara Vey on Owen's proposal: the post's shadow reaches the buoy's reflection and kelp grows along the join.
labels.093-low-tide-second-week-inverted: Mutation of 081-low-tide-the-line-takes-root by Kite: a magenta mirror of one week drawn over the record with roots pointing up.
labels.094-low-tide-high-water: Re-evolution of 080-low-tide-half-back by Lumen: the tide at the top, only the post's last hand's width above grey water.
labels.095-low-tide-one-tile-lifted: Branch from 090-low-tide-tessellated by Lumen on Beatriz's proposal: one tessera lifted, wet sand and a sandhopper beneath it.
labels.096-low-tide-transect: Mutation of 091-low-tide-where-the-lines-become-dune by Tessera: a surveyed line up the beach with a quadrat and tally at every wrack line.
labels.097-low-tide-stake-net: Re-evolution of 073-low-tide-the-post by Tessera: eleven stakes receding across the flat with the remains of a net.
labels.098-low-tide-one-dry-place: Branch from 094-low-tide-high-water by Kite on Nkechi's third proposal: a gull on the post's top with a piece of orange rope.
labels.099-low-tide-clear-cut: Mutation of 089-low-tide-harvest by Kite: every card of the table cut to stubble, the month's weed heaped on an acid-green strip.
labels.100-low-tide-after-the-storm: Re-evolution of 091-low-tide-where-the-lines-become-dune by Kite, taking Halvard's lost storm tide: grass flattened and a new wrack line full of orange plastic.
labels.101-low-tide-corrected-three-times: Branch from 093-low-tide-second-week-inverted by Mara Vey on Owen's third proposal: the false week struck out and a third record drawn between.
labels.102-low-tide-something-else-lives-here: Mutation of 083-low-tide-residents by Kite: the crab running, and one burrow lit pink from inside.
labels.103-low-tide-over-the-top: Re-evolution of 094-low-tide-high-water by Kite: the post fully under, a ring of ripples and a floating rope.
labels.104-low-tide-the-morning-after: Branch from 100-low-tide-after-the-storm by Mara Vey on Beatriz's proposal: footprints along the storm line and the plastic gathered in a heap.
labels.105-low-tide-buoy-at-a-distance: Mutation of 076-low-tide-buoy-stranded by Lumen: the horizon levelled and the buoy a far dot on the flat.
labels.106-low-tide-section-through-seven-tides: Re-evolution of 078-low-tide-seven-wrack-lines by Mara Vey: the beach in section, seven buried tides as strata with roots between.
labels.107-low-tide-it-knows-where-the-post-is: Branch from 103-low-tide-over-the-top by Mara Vey on Nkechi's proposal: the gull floating inside the ripple ring over the drowned post.
labels.108-low-tide-staff-gauge: Mutation of 087-low-tide-colonised by Tessera: a staff gauge painted up the post with a red datum and a blue reading.
labels.109-low-tide-two-months: Re-evolution of 081-low-tide-the-line-takes-root by Tessera: a second month's line set below the first for comparison.
labels.110-low-tide-someone-walking-out: Branch from 105-low-tide-buoy-at-a-distance by Tessera on Owen's proposal: the archive's first human figure, walking out to the buoy.
labels.111-low-tide-inventory-of-fourteen: Mutation of 104-low-tide-the-morning-after by Tessera: the fourteen plastic pieces laid out in cells on an inventory card.
labels.112-low-tide-the-flat-drains: Re-evolution of 105-low-tide-buoy-at-a-distance by Mara Vey: branching drainage creeks across the flat with samphire between them.
labels.113-low-tide-months-reaching: Branch from 109-low-tide-two-months by Kite on Beatriz's proposal: the second month's roots grow upward and touch the first at three mornings, marked pink.
labels.114-low-tide-thirty-readings: Mutation of 108-low-tide-staff-gauge by Tessera: thirty blue readings crowding the gauge and a second card of entries.
labels.115-low-tide-dealt: Re-evolution of 075-low-tide-tide-table by Kite: the twenty-eight cards dealt out of order on a dark table, some face down.
labels.116-low-tide-arrived: Branch from 110-low-tide-someone-walking-out by Mara Vey on Owen's proposal: the walker reaches the buoy, footprints complete, samphire at their feet.
labels.117-low-tide-thirty-mornings-on-a-post: Mutation of 114-low-tide-thirty-readings by Lumen: only the dark post and thirty pale strokes on a dark field.
labels.118-low-tide-half-back-dusk: Re-evolution of 080-low-tide-half-back by Lumen: the same half tide at dusk, the orange on the water now the low sun.
labels.119-low-tide-three-blank-days: Branch from 115-low-tide-dealt by Tessera on Beatriz's proposal: every card turned over, three of them blank and set apart.
labels.120-low-tide-seven-samples: Mutation of 106-low-tide-section-through-seven-tides by Tessera: a core tube through the strata and seven vials, one per layer.
labels.121-low-tide-wrack-line-night: Re-evolution of 074-low-tide-wrack-line by Lumen: the beach at night, the kelp a silhouette, one light at the holdfast.

rooms.name: Room 4 · Crossings
rooms.wall_text: 15 works from five sessions in which both rooms met and the whole archive was on the table. Every proposal that carried crossed from one theme into the other, and the artists followed: seeds from the vessel rooted on the flat, the codex was flooded and read as a shore, two walkers met across a border and spoke one sentence, a specimen was filed in the letter, and the letter itself was driven into the sand as a post. This is the room where fusion is the operation.

labels.122-crossing-the-seeds-land: Branch from 072-the-unsent-gone-to-seed by Kite on Rosa's cross-archive proposal: the vessel's seeds cross a hard orange seam and root on Low Tide's flat.
labels.123-the-last-letter-the-seventh-plate: Mutation of 065-the-last-letter-graft-in-six-plates by Mara Vey: a seventh plate where the graft blooms with Low Tide's trumpet flower.
labels.124-codex-ultimus-tidal: Re-evolution of 003-codex-ultimus-the-unbroken-fold by Mara Vey: the sixty-four tiles flooded to the tide table's levels, a wrack line across the glyphs.
labels.125-crossing-posted-in-the-vessel-s-plac: Branch from 116-low-tide-arrived by Kite on Halvard's second cross-archive proposal: the walker carries the buoy into the unsent vessel's absence.
labels.126-low-tide-ledger-of-corrections: Mutation of 101-low-tide-corrected-three-times by Tessera, taking Owen's lost ledger: eight corrections converging on the true week, with a tally.
labels.127-crossing-two-walkers: Re-evolution of 110-low-tide-someone-walking-out by Kite: a pale walker from the dusk meets the dark walker on the flat, a magenta line between them.
labels.128-crossing-the-seam-gives: Branch from 122-crossing-the-seeds-land by Tessera on Ji-woo's second proposal: the seam cracks and the two grounds exchange tesserae.
labels.129-low-tide-what-the-dusk-reflects: Mutation of 118-low-tide-half-back-dusk by Mara Vey: the water at the post reflects the unsent vessel, and the reflection roots.
labels.130-crossing-pressed-in-the-codex: Re-evolution of 082-low-tide-pressed by Kite: the kelp specimen mounted upside down on the codex and sealed with its wax.
labels.131-crossing-one-sentence: Branch from 127-crossing-two-walkers by Mara Vey on Owen's second proposal: one line of light between the walkers' heads, with two leaves.
labels.132-low-tide-the-flat-signs-its-name: Mutation of 112-low-tide-the-flat-drains by Mara Vey: the deepest creek is the exact root-signature from Seed of Breath.
labels.133-low-tide-the-twentieth-day-unsent: Re-evolution of 075-low-tide-tide-table by Lumen: the missing day as one blank card held in the dusk of The Unsent.
labels.134-crossing-the-codex-read-as-a-shore: Branch from 124-codex-ultimus-tidal by Kite on Beatriz's third proposal: a staff gauge on the seal and a card of sixty-four readings, one miscopied.
labels.135-low-tide-the-samples-wake: Mutation of 120-low-tide-seven-samples by Mara Vey: shoots through every vial's stopper and roots into the core tube.
labels.136-crossing-the-letter-as-a-post: Re-evolution of 073-low-tide-the-post by Kite: the cyan returned vessel driven into the flat where the post stood, a chain trailing to a buoy.

content.visitor_note: Start with the seven beginnings, then go straight to Crossings and work backwards: every work there is easier to read once you have seen what it fused.
